name: scGeneRAI
method_summary: scGeneRAI trains a neural network on static scRNA-seq data to impute masked gene expression values from arbitrary sets of other genes, then applies layer-wise relevance propagation to estimate gene-gene relevance for individual cells. The selected public score is LRPau, an absolute undirected average of reciprocal raw LRP scores for each gene pair.

threading.upstream_mapping: Wrapper maps ANDREA --threads to PyTorch CPU intra-op threads with torch.set_num_threads(threads) before invoking scGeneRAI fit() and predict_networks(). The wrapper also sets OMP, MKL, OpenBLAS, NumExpr, BLIS and Accelerate thread environment variables to the assigned thread count, and keeps PyTorch inter-op threads at 1 to avoid nested oversubscription. scGeneRAI itself uses torch neural-network training and LRP prediction on CPU; it does not expose separate worker/n_jobs parameters.

optional.usage: Optional categorical cell/sample descriptors such as batch, donor, condition or cell type. When provided, the wrapper aligns them to expression columns and passes them as scGeneRAI descriptors during both fit() and predict_networks(); when absent, descriptors are omitted to preserve upstream default behavior.

conditional_required.message: groups is required when execution.mode=group_aggregated because ANDREA aggregates scGeneRAI cell-native network rows by group.
conditional_required.usage: ANDREA uses groups.tsv after the native scGeneRAI per-cell run to aggregate cell:<cell_id> rows into group:<group_id> rows; scGeneRAI itself does not consume groups.tsv.

progress.note: scGeneRAI trains over epochs and predicts by iterating over cells and target genes, but the selected public Python API does not expose a stable progress callback; the wrapper should report coarse lifecycle states in progress.json.

nepochs.description: Maximum number of neural-network training epochs passed to scGeneRAI.fit(). The method paper used 1500 with early stopping.

model_depth.description: Model depth argument passed to scGeneRAI.fit(). Upstream README and example use 2 as the public default.

lr.description: Learning rate for the stochastic gradient descent optimizer passed to scGeneRAI.fit().

batch_size.description: Training minibatch size passed to scGeneRAI.fit().

lr_decay.description: Exponential learning-rate scheduler gamma passed to scGeneRAI.fit(); code and paper use 0.995.

early_stopping.description: Whether scGeneRAI.fit() reloads the model checkpoint with the smallest internal test loss.

artifacts_aux.description: Combined stdout/stderr log from scGeneRAI training and prediction.
Raw per-cell CSV files written by scGeneRAI predict_networks() before conversion to ANDREA network.csv.
Mapping from file-safe internal cell aliases used for upstream result filenames back to original ANDREA expression column identifiers.
